messages.content:
Brief from the lead:
Pull from the record: fare type (refundable or nonrefundable); itinerary (domestic or international); event type (voluntary cancel, carrier cancel, or schedule change); hours since booking; days between booking and departure; whether the traveler claims a medical or bereavement reason; if the carrier acted, whether the traveler accepted an alternative; departure and arrival time changes in minutes. Report facts only, no eligibility judgment.

Record:
task E27-09
fare: nonrefundable
itinerary: domestic
event: voluntary-cancel
hours since booking: 20
booking was made this many days before departure: 10

State only the facts the brief asks for. At most 80 words.

request.system: You decide refund eligibility for a travel company's servicing agent, using only the rule card given.

content.text:

Itinerary: domestic
